Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper steps up to the microphone, a wide smile spreading across his face. He adjusts his hearing aid and begins to speak.

JASPER
Thank You, Thank You. I Am Truly Honored To Receive This Record. I Must Say, I'm Still Not Sure How I Did It. I Guess You Could Say I've Been Living Life To The Fullest For Over A Century!

The crowd erupts in applause as Jasper holds up his plaque, beaming with pride.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper lies in bed, his eyes fixed on the ceiling. He looks old and tired, but his mind is still sharp. He begins to think back to his youth, when he spent hours browsing the internet.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading This Theory Online, About Quantum Immortality. It Said That If You Were Born In A Multiverse, And Every Time You Died, You Would Reincarnate In A Parallel Universe, Then You Would Eventually Live Forever.

Jasper's eyes glaze over as he becomes lost in thought.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
It Made So Much Sense. I Meant, Think About It. If Every Time I Died, I Would Reincarnate In A New Universe, Then I Would Eventually Live Forever. It's Like I'm Already Living Forever.

Jasper's voice becomes a whisper, his words slurring together.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
But What If I'm Not Alone? What If There Are Other Me's Out There, Living Forever In Parallel Universes? What If I'm Just A Drop In The Ocean, A Small Part Of A Much Larger Multiverse?

Jasper's eyes widen in terror as he realizes the implications of his theory.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
Oh God, Oh God, Oh God. I'm Not Alone. I'm Not Alone At All.

Jasper's body begins to shake, his mind racing with the weight of his discovery. He starts to laugh maniacally, his eyes rolling back in his head.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - LATER

Jasper lies in bed, his body wracked with convulsions. His eyes are wide open, staring into the void. He's having a full-blown mental breakdown.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT ALONE. I'M NOT ALONE. I'M NOT ALONE.

The camera zooms out, showing Jasper's frail body, his mind shattered by the weight of his own theory.

FADE TO BLACK.

**THE END**
